messages:
Mariana Costa: hey team — orientation on Mon shows 09:00 PT for me but my Brasil teammates see 13:00 BRT and Argentina shows 14:00 ART. is that expected?
Diego Alvarez: yes that sounds right. PT -> BRT is +4, PT -> ART is +5. are folks seeing two invites though? i had both a Zoom and a Google Meet on my calendar.
Priya Nair: we had a calendar-sync glitch last month that generated a Meet copy for some orgs. canonical invite is from onboarding@redwood.com (Zoom). delete the Meet copy.
Jordan Lee: quick note — i saw double reminders because i had both copies. they fired 24h + 15m twice. very noisy.
Emma Field: ugh i missed a few reminders because mobile grouped them weirdly. what's the easiest way to clean duplicates?
Priya Nair: best: delete the duplicate event and then accept the onboarding calendar invite directly via the group calendar link in your welcome email. or toggle the calendar subscription off/on.
Calendar Sync Bot: Automated: Removed duplicate Google Meet attachment for event 7c9d. Updated title to include explicit timezones: "Orientation — 09:00 PT / 13:00 BRT / 14:00 ART / 21:00 SGT".
Mariana Costa: thanks. will there be a recording and can captions be in Portuguese/Spanish? our LATAM cohort wants local language captions.
Onboarding Bot: Recording: yes. Upload ~30-90 minutes after session to onboarding S3. Auto-captions: English only by default. For Portuguese/Spanish captions, submit request to onboarding@redwood.com within 48 hours of the session and we can add translated captions (turnaround ~24-72 hours). Retention: default 60 days; extended retention available on request.
Diego Alvarez: great — i'll request Portuguese captions after the session. also where are the slides?
Emma Field: slides live in Drive (link in event). we also attach a PDF to the recording page. Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/onboard-latam-2026
Jordan Lee: small UX ask — can event subject include PT label instead of PST and list the Zoom host id so it's visible in clients that hide attachments?
Priya Nair: done. subject now: "Orientation — 09:00 PT (host: onboarding@redwood.com) / 13:00 BRT / 14:00 ART". added Zoom link in subject and top of description.
Mariana Costa: last checklist Q — can we add a short pre-session setup checklist in the calendar description (VPN, Slack, laptop image, install dev certs)? new hires keep DMing about it.
Priya Nair: added checklist and a short bullet for LATAM: "If you cannot join live, the LATAM replay is scheduled the next day at 09:00 BRT (separate event)."
Diego Alvarez: perfect. thanks everyone — cleaned up my calendar and re-accepted the canonical invite.
Jordan Lee: action items summarized: (1) delete duplicates, (2) accept onboarding calendar, (3) check Drive for slides, (4) submit captions request if needed. ping onboarding@redwood.com for help. :thumbsup:
